title: Eventual flatness for finitely presented modules over affine inverse limits
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and let $(R_j)_{j\in I}$ be a directed system of rings with colimit $R$. Fix $i\in I$, and let $A_i\to B_i$ be a map of finitely presented $R_i$-algebras. Let $N_i$ be a finitely presented $B_i$-module. For $j\ge i$ set $A_j=R_j\otimes_{R_i}A_i$, $B_j=R_j\otimes_{R_i}B_i$, and $N_j=R_j\otimes_{R_i}N_i$; set $A=R\otimes_{R_i}A_i$, $B=R\otimes_{R_i}B_i$, and $N=R\otimes_{R_i}N_i$. If $N$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then there exists $j_0\ge i$ such that $N_j$ is flat over $A_j$ for every $j\ge j_0$. (No Noetherian hypothesis is needed.)

proof.text: Apply the flat scalar-extension model theorem to the limit coefficient ring C=c.pt, the fixed algebras Ai,Bi, module Ni and map f. This produces finitely presented P,Q,L, a flat P-module structure on L restricted from Q, the compatible algebra isomorphism e at the limit, and the linear module comparison there.

Use the finite-presentation model comparison theorem with this model. It gives j0 above i and, for every j above j0, a P-algebra structure on Aj and a linear equivalence Aj tensor_P L with Aj tensor_Ai Ni. This step uses no flatness.

Since L is flat over P, its tensor extension to Aj is flat over Aj. Transport this flatness through the inverse of the model comparison linear equivalence. This gives exactly the requested flatness for every j above j0, for every proof of i <= j0.

The proof uses the general openness theorem for flat loci to obtain a finite affine cover.
The proof uses finite-presentation morphism descent to compare the Noetherian model algebra with prescribed stages.
The proof uses elementwise colimit/base-change facts to form the prescribed comparison maps.
The proof uses the general localization-of-filtered-colimit construction for the prime-local systems.
The proof uses the underlying-module colimit statement to identify the localized module colimit.

lean.statement: theorem exists_eventually_flat_of_finitePresentation {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) {i : I} {Ai Bi Ni : Type w} [CommRing Ai] [CommRing Bi] [AddCommMonoid Ni] [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) Ai] [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) Bi] [Module Bi Ni] [Module.FinitePresentation Bi Ni] [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) Ai] [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) Bi] (f : Ai →ₐ[(F.obj i : Type v)] Bi) (hflat : letI : Module Ai Ni := Module.compHom Ni f.toRingHom letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra letI : Algebra Ai ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[(F.obj i : Type v)] Ai) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra Module.Flat ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[(F.obj i : Type v)] Ai) (((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[(F.obj i : Type v)] Ai) ⊗[Ai] Ni)) : (letI : Module Ai Ni := Module.compHom Ni f.toRingHom; ∃ j₀ : I, i ≤ j₀ ∧ ∀ (j : I) (h₀ : i ≤ j₀) (h₁ : j₀ ≤ j), (letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (F.obj j : Type v) := (F.map (homOfLE (h₀.trans h₁))).hom.toAlgebra; letI : Algebra Ai ((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[(F.obj i : Type v)] Ai) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra; Module.Flat ((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[(F.obj i : Type v)] Ai) (((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[(F.obj i : Type v)] Ai) ⊗[Ai] Ni)))
